title: A local cache entry cannot confer release authority
expected: A consuming CI run preserves original output producer facts.
Uploading or signing local content later does not change its local origin.

cases.name: local-to-ci
cases.change: Reuse a local producer descriptor in CI.
cases.expect: Deny production eligibility even when output bytes match.

cases.name: unverified-signature
cases.expect: A signature without verified authority is not sufficient.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
